title: Brent crude climbs toward $90 as US-Iran Hormuz standoff deepens; Trump threatened Oman strike
summary: Brent crude extended gains for a fourth consecutive session approaching $90 per barrel as US-Iran negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz broke down after the 60-day deadline expired without a deal. At least eight attacks on vessels transiting Hormuz were reported in August. President Trump threatened Oman with military strikes and signaled no hurry to end the Iran war, keeping supply-risk premiums elevated.
why: 霍尔木兹局势持续升级推高全球能源成本，加剧通胀压力并支撑美联储偏鹰立场；对港股/A股整体风险偏好形成压制，能源进口依赖的中国经济复苏亦受拖累；事件仍在发酵中。

title: Gold holds near $4,500/oz at two-month high as Treasury buybacks push yields lower
summary: Gold surged to its highest level since early June on August 19, holding near $4,500 per troy ounce, after the US Treasury doubled long-dated bond repurchase operations, driving 30-year Treasury yields sharply lower. The dollar fell to a three-month low, boosting demand for the non-yielding metal, which climbed nearly 4% in two days.
why: 黄金两个月高位对老铺黄金（6181.HK）营收形成正面支撑——其产品定价直接锚定金价；持有6181正股或期权应关注金价能否突破前高信号；sell put可关注波动率窗口。

title: Bitcoin briefly hits $70,000 as Trump urges Congress to pass crypto Clarity Act at White House summit
summary: Bitcoin touched $70,000 for the first time since June 2 after President Trump hosted major cryptocurrency executives including Coinbase, Gemini, Ripple, and Chainlink Labs at the White House on August 20 and called for passage of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act. Ether also surged. The Clarity Act sets a regulatory framework for digital assets and needs 60 Senate votes before November elections.
why: 比特币强势回归$70K、监管框架推进直接利好Circle（CRCL）USDC生态及稳定币赛道；Clarity Act若通过将给加密板块带来估值重估机会；Circle持仓者或期权操作者需关注立法进展。

title: 香港交易所上半年业绩创历史纪录：收入增19%至167亿港元，利润升24%至106亿港元；IPO集资额倍增
summary: 香港交易所（0388.HK）公布2026年上半年业绩：核心收入同比增长19%至155亿港元，归属股东净利润增长24%至106亿港元，均创半年度历史新高。上半年共87家企业在港上市，合计集资212亿港元，同比增长94%，主要由AI、科技及电信企业驱动。
why: 港交所强劲业绩是港股市场活跃度最直接的晴雨表；IPO集资额倍增说明AI科技优质资产供应加速，有利于港股科技持仓中长期逻辑；HKEX当日股价涨逾1.6%。
source: HKEX官方业绩公告（多方确认）
